long_biography.plain_text:
Before Jorge Luis Garcia built a healthcare enterprise in Florida, he arrived from Cuba as a child in a family starting again with little. His parents came without English or immigration papers and supported the household through factory, hotel-cleaning and car-repair work. Garcia combined demanding shifts at a large hospital with classes at a local community college.

That experience became a practical foundation for a network of medical offices across central Florida. Garcia staffed the business with bilingual doctors, widening access for English- and Spanish-speaking patients. He also trained and worked as a physician, bringing clinical knowledge to the diagnostics and medical-services platform he created. His continuing work in general practice reflects the medical focus that shaped both his business and professional life.
